use default

class NEGATIVE_VALUE_EXCEPTION(message: string): System.Exception is
    super(message)
si

risky(n: int) is
    if n < 0 then
        throw NEGATIVE_VALUE_EXCEPTION("negative value: {n}")
    fi

    write_line("ok: {n}")
si

for n in [5, -3, 10] do
    try
        risky(n)
    catch e: NEGATIVE_VALUE_EXCEPTION
        write_line("caught: {e.message}")
    yrt
od
